name: io.github.nicoazel/arcgis-pro-mcp
title: ArcGIS Pro MCP
description: Windows-only ArcGIS Pro gateway. Requires the ArcGIS Pro add-in from the GitHub release.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_PRO_MCP_HOST_PID
environmentVariables.description: Gateway-side. Process id of the ArcGIS Pro instance to attach to when several are running.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_PRO_MCP_PIPE
environmentVariables.description: Gateway-side override of the named pipe. Must equal the value set for ArcGIS Pro (host-side).
